body:
John Merrall wrote:

>The American people know what they want, and
>they deserve to get it good and hard.

as the latest in his south of the border bashing.

May I request that you either come out with your real point or stick to the
point of the thread. Either are acceptable, and there may be some understanding
gained of the problems of U.S.-Canadian relationships.

But, it seems to me that you are stereotyping the American people as reps of
the multinational corporations that are based in the U.S. There is a
difference. Please re-read para. 15, "Leftists... hate America,"  (yes, I know
that includes the whole western hemisphere, but is more generally used for the
U.S. - how would you like to live in a place with just initials and not a real
name? Of course we call it America!)... "...He hates America and the West
because they are strong and successful." I would also recommend paras. 187-188.

Thanks, if you consider this. 

-Susan
